Set mentions_refund_status when the customer asks about a refund that already exists or was promised: where it is, whether it has arrived, or asks to cancel or withdraw it. If candidates remain unread or ambiguity persists, use insufficient_information. Do not replace an explicitly named payment with a different one. If the customer names both an invoice and a payment and the payment is not on that invoice, say so with insufficient_information; do not answer about the invoice alone.
